summary: The person is handed a severance agreement in the same meeting where they learn the job is ending.
realLife: An HR article describes a worker told in a conference room that it was her last day and given a severance agreement at that meeting. The author advises explaining severance clearly.
sources: Workforce magazine, A humane approach to layoffs: https://workforce.com/news/a-humane-approach-to-layoffs
inGame: Job-ended event; severance agreement is not in the game, so it needs: severance and agreement records. Scene: needs a producer for layoff-terms.

turns.summary: The person hears the news first, and the paper arrives in the mail a few days later.
turns.writesBack: The person gets time to think, and the mood is steadier.

turns.summary: The person hears the news and no agreement is offered.
turns.writesBack: The person leaves with the last paycheck only, and the tie cools.

turns.summary: The person refuses to sign at the meeting and takes the paper home.
pulledBy: a friend who knows the rules
turns.writesBack: The terms are bargained later, and the tie to the employer is strained.
